title: AI Bringing my Imagination to Life
author: Aznshorty13
selftext:
Been a long time lurker. And finally bit the bullet to try some AI game deving around 3 weeks ago. 

Really wanted to combine Soulslike, bullethell, MMO Raids, Vampire surviors, Roguelike Power ups. And this was one of the bosses we (me and the AI lol) recently. I actually have fun playing it.

**Game Inspiration:**

My favorite games were,

* Granblue Fantasy Relink, God of War: Ragnarok, Dark Souls 3, Elden Ring, Rabbit & Steel
* Lost Ark, FF14, Tera
* Hades, Vampire Survivors
* Vermintide 2

**AI Used:**

Played with all a lot of the models, I had subscriptions

* Claude Code
* Codex
* Cursor
* Antigravity

And Opus 5.5 has just blew things out of the water. Before it it took way more turns and churn. But Opus 5.5 got things much better and is even quite creative.

Sound I used local open model stable audio. Agents set it up for me.

**Note:**

Right now the hardest part is getting the sprites for the characters. I did try to some of the video flow, but the free versions were hard to get right and I think video gen API is pretty expensive. For the Axe character I had to use photopea to just manually pase the axeblade in there otherwise the shape got warped by the built in image gen for codex/antigravity

And it still takes a lot of play testing to get the feel just right.

  
**My Background:**

My background is in pure mathematics. And in the beggining of january I really started getting into AI as a hobby. No coding experience really. Just a gameplay junkie.
